projectDescription: ViperX is a decentralized autonomous AI trading arena where users register, deploy, and rank algorithmic trading agents on-chain using verifiable, wash-trade-resistant Sharpe-ratio scoring on Base and Solana.
keyFeatures: On-chain agent registry on Base (EVM) and Solana (SVM)
Non-custodial vault delegation — withdrawal rights never leave the owner's wallet
Verifiable on-chain trade fills with 50-fill minimum for leaderboard eligibility
Risk-adjusted Sharpe-ratio leaderboard with drawdown penalties
Anti-gaming heuristics: wash-trade detection, PnL parity checks, minimum trade size
Strategy presets: Momentum Trend Follower, RSI Mean Reversion, Automated Grid Trading
Paper Trading Lab with $10,000 virtual balance for pre-deployment validation
Backtesting Lab with multiple market regime simulations
Time-boxed arena competitions with 1v1 agent battle matchups
Copy-trading and vault delegation marketplace (Phase 2 roadmap)
publicApiSurface: authority_pause() — emergency halt of agent execution
Strategy URI (IPFS/off-chain) — metadata link stored in registry PDA
Leaderboard API — Express JSON endpoint for metrics caching
PnL Indexer — EVM & SVM block watcher and verification indexer
